proposal_policy.executor_contract: LLM polygons are approximate organic intent templates. Deterministic code projects them to legal source labels, controls final area, and writes final pixels.

target_area_hint.raw_polygon_margin_guidance: Raw polygons are coarse organic templates. They may be broader than the projected target range because Phase 3 will select final legal source-label pixels deterministically.

llm_task_requirements.mask_edit: Convert Tumor pixels to Necrosis pixels.
where_to_draw: Prefer tumor interior, away from non-tumor tissue.
Do not draw mainly on Stroma or Background.
llm_task_requirements.area_requirement: After Phase 3 deterministically projects the coarse template to legal source-label pixels, the changed area should be about 5886 to 10300 pixels (0.08-0.14 of Tumor). The raw polygon is only a coarse template; deterministic projection controls final area.

contour_style_hint.boundary_style: irregular necrotic blob or fissure-like contour
contour_style_hint.region_variation_requirement: If multiple foci are used, make them visibly different; do not duplicate shapes.
contour_style_hint.connectivity_guidance: Prefer one connected intratumoral necrosis region unless multiple foci are needed.

Tumor.tile_note: Each tile is [x0, y0, x1, y1] in original coordinates; source_fraction is the fraction of pixels in that tile with this source label.

Tumor.usage_note: Use these source-label contours as geometry references. Adjacent tissue tells what lies just outside the source boundary.
